name: viglet-dumont-wordpress-admin
description: The plugin's admin screens, built with @wordpress/scripts into src/admin/build/.

scripts.build: wp-scripts build health.js mapping.js setup.js tuning.js insights.js --webpack-src-dir=assets/admin --output-path=src/admin/build && node bin/copy-sdk.mjs
scripts.start: wp-scripts start health.js mapping.js setup.js tuning.js insights.js --webpack-src-dir=assets/admin --output-path=src/admin/build && node bin/copy-sdk.mjs
scripts.lint:js: wp-scripts lint-js assets/admin src/public bin src/admin/js/search-block-editor.js src/admin/js/related-block-editor.js src/admin/js/copilot-block-editor.js src/admin/js/compare-block-editor.js src/admin/js/assistant-block-editor.js tests/e2e playwright.config.mjs playwright.ai.config.mjs playwright.demo.config.mjs playwright.tour.config.mjs playwright.story.config.mjs playwright.story-record.config.mjs playwright.story-vertical.config.mjs playwright.developer.config.mjs playwright.playground.config.mjs --ignore-pattern "tests/e2e/artifacts/**"
